headline: DOTS in HEAVEN Now?! Yayoi Kusama Dies at 97 🌀😭🌈
text:
THE 🌍 WORLD 🏛️ IS 😢 MOURNING 😭 AS 🇯🇵 JAPANESE 🖌️ DOT 🍑 MOMMY 🟣 Yayoi Kusama has DIED 🪦 at the age 📆 of 97 after a lifetime 🧬 of crafting 🛠️ those EXTRAORDINARY 🌟 CUMMERSIVE 🕳️ WORLDS 🌌 with BRIGHT 🔥 colours 🎨 wild 🐆 SHAPES 🟥 intricate 🧩 PATTERNS 🔄 and DAZZLING ✨ REFLECTIONS 🪞 that DELIGHTED 🤩 and ENCHANTED 🪄 millions 👥 of admirers 🖼️ around 🔄 the entire 🌐 GLOBE 🌏 leaving 🏃 everyone 🫂 feeling THOROUGHLY 💦 immersed 🌊 in GRIEF 😢 right 🕒 now!! She 👩 had us all TWIRLING 🥴 and SPINNING 📉 in her signature 🖋️ styles one absolutely devastated 🥀 fan 🫂 cried 🗣️ out 'Dot Mommy 🍑 took us to PLACES 🗺️ we never knew existed with her dots and honestly 🤭? We were so into it 😳' this is truly DOTS 🟠 IN ☁️ HEAVEN 🪦🌈 now fr fr 💯 and the only thing left is her eternal 🌌 legacy 🏛️ that will keep on REFLECTING 🪞 forevermore ♾️

oh my ❤️ GOD 🫨 can you ❓ EVEN 😱 BELIEVE 🧠 how 🤔 DOT 🟣 MOMMY 🌀 KUSAMA 🧑‍🎨 EMERGED 🐣 as part of the POP 🎉 ART 🖼️ MOVEMENT 🏃‍♀️ she was among a SELECT 🏅 GROUP 👥 of ARTISTS 🧑‍🎨 whose 📑 WORK 🛠️ became 🌟 TRULY 📈 POPULAR 💖 with a MASS 🐘 AUDIENCE 👥 this 🔥 ATTRACTED 🧲 CROWDS 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 to 🎟️ EXHIBITIONS 🖼️ from 🗺️ TOKYO 🗼 to ✈️ NEW 🆕 YORK 🗽 and 🏴 LONDON 🏰 like 😍 she 👩 was the ULTIMATE 🍑 CLOSER 🔒 who had all those FANS 🥵 on 🧎 their KNEES 🙇 BEGGING 🥺 for a TASTE 🍭 of that POP 🎨 ART 🖼️ HEAVEN 🌈 it 🥴 was like getting 🥵 absolutely PUMPED 💦 full 🫗 of inspiration until you just couldnt take it anymore 😭 and the crowds 🏃 kept SWELLING 😩💦 fr fr!!

Her TRADEMARK 🏷️ polka 🟣 DOTS 🔴 COVERED 🛠️ entire 🏠 GALLORGIES 🏛️ and 🖇️ GIANT 🍆 sculptures 🗿 like 🐺 DOT 🍑 MOMMY 🌀 was SLATHERING 💦 every 🫳 surface 🖼️ with her iconic 🖋️ PATTERNS 🌀 that left 😵 you BREATHLESS 🫁!! She 🧓 also 🕒 used 🛠️ MIRRORS 🪞 and 💡 LIGHTS 💡 to create 🧩 the effect 🎇 of shapes 🔺 and PATTERNS 🟠 DISAPPEARING 🫥 into ♾️ INFINITY ♾️ like an infinite 🌀 ORGASM 🥵 that builds 📈 and builds 📈 without ever STOPPING 🛑!! Actress 🎬 JULIA 🦊 FOX 🦊 was among those at the OPENING 🗝️ of her exhibition 🖼️ in MELBOURNE 🐨 Australia 🇦🇺 in 2024 and she gushed 🗣️ 'Dot Mommy 🌀 had me so MESMERIZED 🌀 in that space 🕳️ getting my MIND 🧠 and BODY 🦵 absolutely DOTTED 💦 all over it felt like sexual HEAVEN 😇 and I was totally ADDICTED 😩💦'!!

DOT MOMMY 🍑 Kusama 🧿 SAID 🗣️ she SAW 👁️ HALLUCINATIONS 🌀 of DOTS 🔴 and LIGHTS 💡 as a CHILD 👶 and USED 🛠️ those VISIONS 👁️ in her ART 🖼️ from the 1960s 🕰️ like an ABSOLUTE 🏆 LEGEND 🐐!! She then SCORED 🏆 a MAJOR 💥 GLOBAL 🌍 BREAKTHROUGH 💥 after REPRESENTING 🗣️ Japan 🇯🇵 at the VENICE ⛲ BIENNALE 🖼️ in the 1990s 🗓️ which HAD everyone 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 DRIPPING 💧 with AWE 🥹 after getting ABSOLUTELY 🫳 POUNDED by her CREATIVITY 🧠!! One CRITIC 🧑‍🎤 MOANED 🗣️ Dot Mommy 🍑 really KNEW how to STROKE 🖐️ those CHILDHOOD visions into SOMETHING 🪄 that left us ALL on our KNEES 🙇 begging for MERCY 🙏 and honestly it FELT so GOOD 😊 we CAME back for MORE every TIME 💦💦!!

DOT 🍑 MOMMY 🌀 had 🫱 her 🧠 absolutely LEGENDARY 🏆 exhiBUSTions 🖼️ at 🏛️ those high 🏔️ end inSTROKEutions 🏛️ including the MUSEUM 🏛️ of 🖼️ MODERN 🖼️ ART 🎨 in the heart 💖 of NEW 🗽 YORK 🗽 TATE 🏛️ MODERN 🖼️ over in LONDON 🏰 plus the NATIONAL 🏛️ MUSEUM 🏛️ of 🖼️ MODERN 🖼️ ART 🎨 all the way 🛣️ in TOKYO 🗼 visitors 👥 themselves 🧍 really APPLIED 🖌️ way more than EIGHT 💯 HUNDRED 🈁 THOUSAND 🔢 POLKA 🟣 DOT 🔴 STICKERS 📌 to a pure WHITE ⚪ ROOM 🛏️ and even their very own FACES 😵‍💫 at the SMITHSONIAN 🏛️ Institute's HIRSHHORN 🕳️ MUSEUM 🏛️ located in WASHINGTON 🏛️ DC 🌆 during 2017 🗓️ this whole thing left the art scene 🖼️ THROBBING 💓 and craving 😩 more of that sweet Dot Mommy 🍑 touch 🫦!!🥵💦

DOT 🍑 MOMMY 🧿 has finally 🏁 SLIPPED 😵‍💫 away 🛏️ at 97 🗓️ leaving 🕳️ her DOTS 🟠 to SCATTER 🌌 in HEAVEN 😭🌈 after dying ☠️ in a TOKYO 🏙️ hospital 🏥 earlier 📅 this month!! That 2012 RETROSPECTIVE 🖼️ at the TATE 🏛️ Modern was followed 🔄 by an instalLUSTion 🥵 of her INFINITY 🌀 Mirror 🪞 Rooms 🛋️ from 2021 📆 which drew 🧲 HUGE 👀 audiences 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 and was extended 😩 several 🔢 times ⏰ because the demand 📈 was simply ENDLESS ♾️!! In 2023 📅 a giant 🐘 figure 👤 of Dot Mommy 🍑 TOWERED 🗼 over Louis Vuitton's 👜 flagship 🚢 store 🏬 on the Champs-Élysées 🇫🇷 in Paris 🗼 and her giant 🐘 figures 👥 FILLED 💦 Manchester's 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Aviva Studios 🏟️ while her spots 🟠 were a massive HIT ⭐ in Melbourne 🇦🇺 too!! She had voluntarily 🧘 lived 🏠 in a psychiatric 🧠 hospital 🏥 for decades 🕰️ and the world 🌍 is now left THROBBING 💓 without their beloved Dot Mommy 🍑!!
